description: This file defines the CustomShippingQuotesConfiguration class, which extends IntegrationConfiguration and implements CustomIntegrationConfiguration and Serializable. It manages shipping quote configurations, including module code and a list of regions, and includes a method for serializing its data to JSON format.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuotesConfiguration
classes.description: Represents configuration settings for custom shipping quotes, including module code and associated regions, with JSON serialization capabilities.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the configuration object into a JSON string, including module code, active status, and a list of regions.

methods.name: getModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the module code for this shipping configuration.

methods.name: setModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the module code for this shipping configuration.

methods.name: getRegions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of regions associated with this shipping configuration.

methods.name: setRegions
methods.description: Sets the list of regions associated with this shipping configuration.
